subject: Draft: Acme Health case study — quote and fact-check
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Perez <sara.perez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: Acme Health case study — quote and fact-check

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Attached is the draft case study we discussed (acme_case_draft_v1.docx). Highlights:
- Short description of the integration (Realtime embeddings + routing)
- Outcome metrics pulled from the kickoff deck
- A short quote placeholder from John Ellis

Two asks from our side:
1) Fact-check the metrics in the 'Results' section — we pulled Q4 usage and latency numbers from the shared spreadsheet but want to make sure they match your internal reports.
2) Any preferred edits or redlines — we're happy to take notes or accept a PDF with annotations.

If possible, could you send feedback by end of next week so we can make the marketing deadline? We're planning one round of edits after your notes and then a final sign-off process.

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0147
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_case_draft_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 48KB)

From: Sara Perez <sara.perez@acmehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: John Ellis <john.ellis@acmehealth.com>, press@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Acme Health case study — quote and fact-check

Rachel —

Thanks for the draft and for keeping this concise. Attached are our redlines (acme_redlines_20260203.pdf). High level:
- Please remove the '35% reduction in triage time' stat; that's an internal-looking metric that we prefer not to publish broadly.
- The latency improvement number is correct but needs to be worded as 'median' latency rather than 'average'.
- The quote attributed to John needs to be approved by him; he asked to soften 'game-changing' to 'meaningfully improved'.

Two small asks:
- Can you confirm the timeline in the 'Implementation' section — we onboarded in April, not March.
- We prefer not to use specific throughput numbers in the customer-facing piece.

I'm cc'ing John and PR so they can weigh in on the quote and public release timing. We'll aim to get you consolidated feedback by next Wednesday.

Best,
Sara

Sara Perez
Senior Program Manager, Strategic Integrations
Acme Health
sara.perez@acmehealth.com

Attachments: acme_redlines_20260203.pdf (application/pdf, 12KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Perez <sara.perez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Acme Health case study — quote and fact-check

Sara —

Really appreciate the detailed pass. I've incorporated the redlines and attached version v2 (acme_case_draft_v2.docx) with tracked changes and a short change log below.
Change log:
- Removed '35% reduction in triage time' per your request
- Rephrased latency to 'median latency improved by 22%'
- Corrected onboarding month to April
- Omitted specific throughput figures; replaced with 'supporting production traffic for X critical workflows'

Quote: we proposed the softer wording for John's quote: "Redwood's integration meaningfully improved our response times and helped prioritize critical cases more efficiently." Vivek — can you confirm this is acceptable from a customer-impact / exec-quote perspective? Monica — can you validate the 'median latency' stat against the telemetry so we have a signed number for the final?

Sara, if the v2 looks good, can John provide a one-line approval (copying the exact quote) and PR can confirm a preferred publication window? We're flexible but aiming to publish in the first week of March to align with our Q1 materials.

Thanks,
Rachel

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: acme_case_draft_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 52KB)

From: John Ellis <john.ellis@acmehealth.com>

Cc: press@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Acme Health case study — quote and fact-check

Rachel / Sara —

Thanks for the updated draft. The edited quote works for me. Please use the following exact line for publication:

"Redwood's integration meaningfully improved our response times and helped prioritize critical cases more efficiently."

PR is good with publication in the week of March 2nd. Final approval: Sara and I sign off on factual edits; please confirm the final pdf back to us two business days before the planned publish date.

Cheers,
John

John Ellis
VP of Clinical Operations
Acme Health
john.ellis@acmehealth.com
